analysis.title: EXTREME HAZARD DOSSIER: ENVIRONMENTAL PROFILES
analysis.description: A sci-fi/dossier-themed infographic presentation slide detailing three environmental hazard profiles: High Temperature, High Pressure, and High Salt Concentration. Each category is displayed in a vertical column featuring an image with sci-fi HUD frames, an identified subject organism, and its corresponding functional adaptation.
analysis.layout: Header at top center with main title and confidential subtitle. Three parallel vertical card containers arranged horizontally across the slide (left: High Temperature in cyan/yellow, middle: High Pressure in orange/red, right: High Salt Concentration in magenta/yellow). Bottom status bar across the base.

components.visibleText:
EXTREME HAZARD DOSSIER: ENVIRONMENTAL PROFILES
CONFIDENTIAL FILE – AUTHORIZED PERSONNEL ONLY.
HAZARD LEVELS: CRITICAL | STATUS: ACTIVE | FILE REF: EX-003

HIGH TEMPERATURE
Subject: Thermophilic bacteria.
Functional Adaptation:
Specialized enzymes that do
not denature at boiling points.

HIGH PRESSURE
Subject: Deep-sea microbes and
invertebrates.
Functional Adaptation:
Pressure-resistant cell
membranes.

HIGH SALT CONCENTRATION
Subject: Halobacteria.
Functional Adaptation: Internal
chemistry adapted to prevent
fatal water loss via osmosis.
